ownership.summary: Dirt Devil says it is part of TTI Floor Care North America. TTI's 2025 annual report includes Dirt Devil in its Floorcare & Cleaning portfolio and identifies Royal Appliance Mfg. Co. in its subsidiary list. TTI's historical report records the 2003 acquisition of Royal Appliance, including the Dirt Devil line. These records establish ownership, but not the seller or factory for every current product.
ownership.parentCompany: Techtronic Industries Company Limited through TTI Floor Care North America

productPortfolio.name: Cordless standing and stick vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: Lightweight cordless floorcare including a self-standing, convertible stick-vac format.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify voltage, runtime, included tools and regional battery or charger requirements by model.

productPortfolio.name: Cordless hand vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: Compact 8V, 12V and 16V lithium-ion hand-vac models for quick pickup, vehicle and wet-dry use cases.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Check battery capacity, wet-use limits, charging stand contents and replacement-filter availability.

productPortfolio.name: Upright and canister vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: Multi-surface, upright and compact canister formats for broader residential floorcare.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm brush-roll, filtration, cord, bag and spare-parts specifications on the contracted SKU.

productPortfolio.name: Carpet, steam and manual cleaning
productPortfolio.positioning: Adjacent home-cleaning categories including portable carpet, steam and manual-cleaning tools.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Treat these as separate service and consumables systems rather than extensions of the vacuum warranty.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: TTI's 2025 annual report identifies Royal Appliance Mfg. Co. as a wholly owned principal subsidiary engaged in floorcare trading and manufacturing.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm whether Royal Appliance, another TTI entity or a named factory is the contracted manufacturer and seller.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Dirt Devil's official site identifies the brand as part of TTI Floor Care North America and describes Royal, now TTI, as making floorcare products for major U.S. retailers.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify the authorized U.S. seller, warranty program and serial-range eligibility for the specific product.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: TTI reports a global manufacturing and sourcing network, but that parent-level disclosure is not a factory declaration for every Dirt Devil model.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match origin, manufacturer, compliance declaration and shipment documentation to the exact SKU.

marketsChannels.evidence: Dirt Devil sells through its U.S. site and says Royal products are sold through major retailers across the country.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm seller authorization, current stock, returns and warranty coverage for the target account.

marketsChannels.evidence: Its product and manuals pages list individual models across cordless, upright, canister, spot-cleaning and steam categories.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Use the exact model number when checking manuals, parts, safety documentation and service support.

marketsChannels.evidence: TTI's annual report describes shared Floorcare & Cleaning management across Hoover, Dirt Devil, Oreck and Vax.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Do not infer a common local distributor, warranty route or factory from the shared group structure alone.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Dirt Devil occupies TTI's value-oriented consumer-floorcare portfolio, where compact cordless and handheld formats can support high-volume retail placement. The strategic advantage is access to a broader TTI product, manufacturing and channel system. The buyer-side constraint is the same as across the group: verify the exact legal entity, retail authorization, warranty and manufacturer instead of treating portfolio membership as a complete supply-chain answer.
